commands.name: mcp-validate
commands.content:
```bash
# Validate MCP configuration
node validate-mcp-config.js .mcp.json

# Test MCP server connection
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/mcp/tools
```

commands.name: mcp-test
commands.content:
```bash
# Start MCP server
npm run mcp:start

# Run MCP integration tests
npm test -- mcp

# Test specific tool
npm run mcp:test-tool -- tool_name
```

commands.name: mcp-generate
commands.content:
```bash
# Generate new MCP tool
npm run mcp:generate -- tool-name

# Generate from template
npm run mcp:scaffold -- --template=database
```
